verdict: Organic activity slowed sharply this week; paid channels remain paused.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all activity came exclusively from your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google has been paused for the full period, so no paid leads or spend are in these numbers. Your profile generated 47 actions this period (calls, direction requests, and website clicks), but that activity dropped steeply in the most recent 7 days, falling 87% compared to the prior 7-day stretch, with zero GBP actions recorded over the last four days. Website sessions followed the same direction, averaging roughly 5 visits per day in the last few days versus a higher baseline earlier in the period. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate next step, which will restore a reliable lead source and reduce exposure to organic fluctuations like the one seen this week.

drop in profile actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days
